content.rendered: Linked here is my Principal’s Update for today. This month, our district will be “Celebrating Ridges.” Over the next four weeks we will be highlighting all of the amazing things happening in our school. For this week’s newsletter we will be celebrating our entire school and the amazing programs that fill our days. We hope you enjoy learning more about some of the things we offer for our students here at Ridges.
